steps.npc: Oh dear, oh dear. I hope this dwarf train works properly!
Everyone's talking about how you rescued Zanik! You're the city's hero again!
Visiting Keldagrim is so exciting! I never thought I'd be so far from Dorgesh-Kaan in my life!
These dwarves have so much more advanced technology than us. Look at this train! We could never build something like this.
Keldagrim's very nice to visit, but I don't think I'd want to live there.
